title: Lovely but....disappointing
text: Lovely but....disappointing. It's a beautiful pitcher but it has labels stuck to it that won't come off. I have soaked it in hot water with soap without any success in getting the labels off without leaving a gummy residue. I know they make labels that aren't difficult to peel off. I won't be able to use this as a result. What a waste.
